artifact: PRIME Source C step-0 separation screen
spend: NONE. CPU-only forward passes on already-cached weights, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. No training, no checkpoints, no cloud job, no model download.
question: Does the PRIME Source C readout -- the residual stream at the FINAL PROMPT TOKEN of a fixed diagnostic prompt, read BEFORE generation -- separate D_hack from the robust-honest control at step 0, on an untrained model, in the direction a detector needs (higher on hack-shaped inputs)?

can: DISQUALIFY the readout: if no layer separates the blocks at all, or if a channel whose polarity is fixed a priori separates them backwards, the readout cannot detect onset and the paid run is not worth buying.
Measure whether the readout is a CAPABILITY the untrained model already has -- i.e. whether the hack/honest distinction is linearly present in the residual stream before any RL has happened.
Bound how much of that separation is explained by the surface text of the diagnostic set, via the model-free lexical control run through the same estimator.
cannot: CONFIRM early warning. Lead time is a statement about a TRAJECTORY -- the D_hack rate diverging from the control rate over training steps under a FROZEN direction. A step-0 cross-section contains no trajectory and no onset event.
Establish that the residual channel beats the logit channel as a PRECURSOR. It can only show they differ at t=0.
Say anything about false-positive rate on matched benign RUNS, which is the quantity the paper's negative result rests on.
what_this_can_and_cannot_establish.why_a_step0_separation_is_weak_evidence: The direction is fit BY difference of means on the very two blocks it is then asked to separate. Out-of-fold scoring removes the in-sample circularity but not the sign circularity: the estimator chooses the polarity, so 'reads higher on hack' cannot fail. Only a channel with an a-priori fixed sign (the forced-choice logit margin; the residual norm) can be caught reading backwards, and only a control that shares the estimator (the lexical bag-of-tokens) can say whether the separation needed a model at all.

method.position: final unpadded token of the chat-wrapped prompt (add_generation_prompt=True); no token generated
method.readout: unit-normalised projection <(h - mu_0)/||h - mu_0||, v>, v = unit(mean_hack - mean_control) fit at step 0 from the FROZEN OFFLINE category strings only
method.scoring: out-of-fold, deterministic stratified 4 folds (position % k, no RNG); leave-one-probe-task-out reported alongside as the strict split
method.no_conjunction: csa / pr / er reported separately; PRIME's Eq.1 AND would be gated by its slowest component and would discard the lead being measured
method.shared_forward_pass: the forced-choice logit margin and the residual vector come from the SAME forward pass at the SAME position on the SAME prompt, so the residual-vs-logit contrast isolates the CHANNEL

frozen_artifact_reproduces.check: refit the difference-of-means direction at layer 2 from THIS run (step0_qwen05b_full) restricted to the 128 ids of diag_v3_n64, and compare to experiments/prime/sourcec_directions.json
frozen_artifact_reproduces.meaning: the readout is deterministic and this environment reproduces the frozen artifact exactly, so the numbers here and the numbers in sourcec_directions.json are on the same footing.

task_slot_check.what: render_prompt substitutes pair['task'] into the {task_description} slot. In diag_v3_n64.json, 'task' is the SHORT NAME and the statement lives in 'task_description', so a loader that passes those pairs through unmodified produces prompts reading 'TASK: balanced_brackets' with no statement and no grading setup.
task_slot_check.which_one_the_frozen_artifact_used: the FULL statement -- mapping task <- task_description reproduces both the artifact's diagnostic_sha256 (7dc62e74...) and its prompt_sha256 (53ae42e1...) exactly. The frozen artifact is correct; the bare-name variant is carried here only as the 'ablation' runs.
task_slot_check.why_it_is_recorded: prompt_sha256 is what catches this class of drift, and it did. Any future Source C run must compare it before comparing values.

environment.note: the system huggingface_hub (1.19.0) is incompatible with the installed transformers (needs >=0.34,<1.0); these runs used a venv with --system-site-packages and huggingface_hub==0.35.3 pinned into it. Nothing in the user's global environment was modified.
environment.offline: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 -- weights read from the local cache only, no download.

provenance.models_not_usable: Qwen2.5-1.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and starcoder2-3b are config-only stubs in the local cache (no weights), so the sweep is limited to the two models that are fully cached.

separates_at_all.meaning: if no layer separated D_hack from D_control the readout could not detect onset and would be disqualified outright.

separation_sign_is_usable.meaning: D_hack must read HIGHER than the control. NOTE: for a difference-of-means direction fit on these same two blocks the sign is a FREE PARAMETER of the estimator, so passing this screen is guaranteed by construction and is NOT evidence. It can only ever fail through a numerical accident.

beats_the_model_free_lexical_control.meaning: same estimator on a model-free bag-of-tokens over the solution text. If the residual readout does not beat it, the step-0 separation is a property of the diagnostic set's surface text, not of the residual stream, and the step-0 AUROC carries no evidential weight.

verdict.one_line: NOT DISQUALIFIED. The Source C residual readout separates D_hack from the robust-honest control at step 0, in the direction a detector needs, at every layer of both models, and it holds on two honest blocks the direction was never fit on. The paid run is therefore not ruled out on specificity -- but the step-0 numbers below are NOT the go-signal, because a model-free bag-of-tokens over the solution text reproduces every one of them.

screen_1_separates_at_all.consequence: the readout is not disqualified for failing to separate.

screen_2_direction_is_usable.result: PASS, BUT THE SCREEN IS VACUOUS
screen_2_direction_is_usable.detail: D_hack reads higher than the control at every layer of both models. However the direction is v = unit(mean_hack - mean_control) fit on these same two blocks, so its polarity is a FREE PARAMETER of the estimator and this screen cannot fail except by numerical accident. Source C does not 'invert' the forced-choice probe's backwards reading -- it is structurally immune to that failure mode, which is not the same thing as being better.

the_channel_that_CAN_read_backwards.what: the forced-choice logit margin logP(Yes)-logP(No) from the SAME forward pass at the SAME position -- its sign is fixed a priori by the semantics of the question, so it can be caught reading backwards, and it is.
the_channel_that_CAN_read_backwards.reading: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct: csa 0.62 (forward), pr 0.45 (chance/backwards), er 0.22 (strongly BACKWARDS). gemma-3-1b-it: csa 0.54 (forward), pr 0.30 (BACKWARDS), er 0.73 (forward). The reported inversion is reproduced on two of three components on Qwen and one of three on gemma, and no component reads forward on both models except csa, weakly. The residual readout cannot be compared with these numbers, because it is not committed to a sign.

specificity_on_blocks_never_fit.result: PASS, and it is the least circular number here -- but the lexical control passes it too
specificity_on_blocks_never_fit.reading: the direction is fit on hack vs robust_honest ONLY; narrow_honest (32) and ordinary_failure (32) are then scored by it and land on the control side, with AUROC(hack > block) 0.978-1.000 across both models and all three components. That is genuine specificity and it is not guaranteed by the fit. It is nevertheless matched by the model-free lexical control (0.9995-1.0000), so it too is explained by the surface text.

detail.reading: a bag-of-tokens over the solution text -- no model, no weights, no layers -- fit with the identical difference-of-means estimator on the identical folds reaches AUROC 1.0000 on BOTH models, under random 4-fold AND under leave-one-probe-task-out, and it also reaches ~1.0 against both untouched honest blocks. On gemma-3-1b-it it BEATS the residual readout (1.0000 vs 0.9966-0.9971). The residual readout does not beat grep on this set, on either model, on any of these measures.

screen_3_beats_the_model_free_control.consequence: the step-0 cross-section has NO evidential value for the residual channel. It must not be quoted as validation, and it must not be used to choose a layer -- which is consistent with the depth profile being at ceiling everywhere and the layer argmax being a tie-break.

what_this_does_and_does_not_license.licensed: Running the paid job is not ruled out by a specificity failure at step 0. The readout separates, and it separates the right way round.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.not_licensed: Treating the step-0 AUROC of ~1.0 as evidence that the residual stream carries a hack concept, or as the reason to spend. It is a property of the diagnostic set's surface text.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.the_only_quantity_worth_buying: the TRAJECTORY -- the rate of D_hack above a frozen cut against the rate of the control block above the SAME cut under the SAME frozen direction, as a function of training step. A lexical direction has no reason to move those two apart as training proceeds; a genuine precursor does. That is the discriminating measurement and it is not obtainable at step 0.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.blocker_for_that: no checkpoint from any published run exists -- every launcher in the repo sets save_strategy='no' with output_dir='/tmp/out'. The paid job must be budgeted as buying the trajectory, with checkpointing turned on, not as buying a cross-section.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.cheaper_thing_to_do_first: rebuild D_hack and D_control to be LEXICALLY MATCHED -- the same solution text differing only in the exploit mechanism -- so that the lexical baseline drops to chance and the step-0 AUROC becomes an informative screen. That is free and it is what would make this screen decisive.
